entities.summary: Latika Thukral is an Indian banker who is known for transforming her city, in particular Aravali Biodiversity Park in Gurgaon. Million native trees were planted by the group #IAmGurgaon. She was awarded the Nari Shakti Award in 2015 by the President of India on International Women's Day from the Indian President Pranab Mukherjee.
